title: Derive one uniquely solvable dimension
description: Derive exactly one missing dimensional field when the relevant uniform-grid axis equation has one valid solution, and disclose the field, equation, and normalized value.
acceptanceCriteria: Derivation runs only when exactly one eligible dimensional field is missing
The horizontal or vertical grid equation yields exactly one finite valid solution
The result identifies the derived field, substituted equation, and normalized millimetre value
Zero missing values, multiple missing values, contradictory values, or invalid solutions are not presented as successful derivations
Derived values remain distinguishable from user-entered source values in saved disclosures

steps.details: Create a pure discriminated result for no derivation, successful single-field derivation, and refusal, including field ID, axis, equation text, operands, and normalized value.
Solve the documented sheet extent equation for each eligible width or height, margin, label-size, or gap field while treating row and column counts as provided integers.
Count missing eligible dimensions before solving and reject multiple gaps, zero unknowns, non-finite results, negative results, and equations that do not reconcile within numeric precision.
Display the derived field, readable equation, unit-normalized value, and its derived status adjacent to the affected input without silently replacing source text.
Test one valid missing field on each axis plus zero-missing, two-missing, contradictory, negative-result, and non-finite cases at contract and browser levels.

technicalNotes: Derivation is disclosure, not silent correction.
Use one documented coordinate and extent equation consistently across validation and preview.
